items.name: sohaibdevv/youtube-music
items.full_text: A lightweight, ad‑free client for streaming music from YouTube Music. No subscription required. Supports background playback, search, and custom playlists via the reverse‑engineered API.

items.name: shadcn-ui/chatbot-template
items.full_text: A minimal chatbot template built with Next.js, AI SDK, shadcn/ui, shadcn/react, shadcn/typeset. It runs on the Vercel AI Gateway.

items.name: CureJe/sedentary-reminder
items.full_text: Stand Up Buddy is a lightweight desktop app for Windows and macOS that reminds you to take regular breaks. Animated characters appear with unique motions and sounds, encouraging you to stretch, move, and reduce discomfort from prolonged sitting.
